title: ID0447893-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / S2 170003305] charger connected to the faulty dispenser
description:
Report issue:
The 2 charge points of the dispenser are out of order since 03/09 at
13:58, with the vendor error "SICHARGE D secc is initializing".
There is no problem on the other charge points.
According to experience based on similar SECC issues on other
chargers, this problem may be solved by a software update to the
v8.
Solution: Replace KF214
yyyy-mm-dd:NA
